prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. THREE separate low forest shrub sprites, one horizontal row of three equal cells. Left squat rounded dense broadleaf bush; center asymmetrical spreading medium shrub with sparse pink/yellow buds; right taller rounded forest bush with layered leaves and a few young shoots. All compact, no trunk tree, no ground mound. Keep each whole silhouette within central 60% of its cell with wide blank margins on all sides. Source 1 original forest bush defines broadleaf forms and modest flower accents. Source 2–3 approved pet sheets provide edge/shading compatibility only. Octopath Traveler HD-2D environment PIXEL ART, restrained earthy moss/olive/sage greens and weathered umber materials, cool desaturated dark hue-tinted edges, warm subtle upper-left key, broad readable color clusters, 3–4 tones/material. No fluorescent greens, candy saturation, smooth vector edges or illustrative microtexture. Upright front billboards seen from 24 degrees above. No baked ground shadows, lighting glow, fog or scenery. Actual engine lighting comes later. Moss/olive/sage foliage, muted tiny flowers, legible as 120–170px bodies. Background exactly pure solid #FF00FF. No labels, typography, drop shadow, fog or backdrop.
source_card: Original low broadleaf forest bush and floral accents. Three silhouettes required by forest kit, no invented scene.
